title.en: Unit 4: Holy Cities, the Elephant Story and the King Najashi
title.ur: Unit 4: Muqaddas shehar, Ashab-ul-Feel aur Najashi badshah

intro.en: A reading text about Makkah, Madinah and Al-Quds (Jerusalem) and the three mosques the Prophet ﷺ named. Read slowly, sentence by sentence. In the exercises you also practise broken plurals (e.g. قَلْب → قُلوب).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Makkah, Madinah aur Al-Quds (Baitul Maqdis) ke baare mein parhne ka matn hai, aur un teen masjidon ka zikr jin ka naam Nabi ﷺ ne liya. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein. Mashqon mein jam-e-taksir bhi seekhenge (jaise قَلْب → قُلوب).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ وَالقُدْسِ وَالمَساجِدِ الثَّلاثَةِ الَّتي ذَكَرَها النَّبِيُّ ﷺ. اقْرَأْهُ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً، ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى جَمْعِ التَّكْسيرِ مِثْلَ قَلْب وَجَمْعُهُ قُلوب.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «لا تُشَدُّ الرِّحالُ إِلا إِلى ثَلاثَةِ مَساجِدَ: المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ، وَمَسْجِدي هَذا، وَالمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصى».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūl: lā tushaddu r-riḥālu illā ilā thalāthati masājid: al-masjidi l-ḥarām, wa masjidī hādhā, wa l-masjidi l-aqṣā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: travel is not undertaken except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque, this mosque of mine, and Al-Aqsa Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: safar ka iraada sirf teen masjidon ke liye kiya jaye: Masjid-e-Haram, meri yeh masjid aur Masjid-e-Aqsa.

dialogue.ar: مَكَّةُ المُكَرَّمَةُ: أَشْهَرُ مُدُنِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ؛ تَهْفو إِلَيْها قُلوبُ المُسْلِمينَ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: Makkatu l-Mukarrama: ashhāru mudāni l-ʿālami l-islāmiyy; tahfū ilayhā qulūbu l-muslimīna jamīʿā
dialogue.en: Makkah is the most famous city of the Muslim world; the hearts of all Muslims long for it.
dialogue.ur: Makkah Mukarrama musalman duniya ka sab se mashhoor shehar hai; tamam musalmanon ke dil us ki taraf maail rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ مَسْقَطُ رَأْسِ الرَّسولِ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَمَبْعَثُهُ، فيها نَزَلَ الوَحْيُ.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya masqaṭu raʾsi r-rasūli Muḥammad wa mabʿathuh, fīhā nazala l-waḥy
dialogue.en: It is the birthplace of the Messenger Muhammad ﷺ and where he was sent; revelation came down in it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Rasool Muhammad ﷺ ki jaay-e-paidaish aur jaay-e-bi'sat hai; is mein wahi nazil hui.

dialogue.ar: يَقْصِدُها مَلايينُ الحُجّاجِ كُلَّ عامٍ لِأَداءِ فَريضَةِ الحَجِّ.
dialogue.tr: yaqṣiduhā malāyīnu l-ḥujjāji kulla ʿām li-adāʾi farīḍati l-ḥajj
dialogue.en: Millions of pilgrims head to it every year to perform the duty of Hajj.
dialogue.ur: Har saal lakhon hujjaj Hajj ka farz ada karne ke liye yahan aate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي مَكَّةَ الكَعْبَةُ المُشَرَّفَةُ وَالمَسْجِدُ الحَرامُ، وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī Makkata l-Kaʿbatu l-Musharrafa wa l-masjidu l-ḥarām, wa huwa awwalu baytin wuḍiʿa li-n-nās
dialogue.en: In Makkah are the honoured Kaaba and the Sacred Mosque, the first house set up for people.
dialogue.ur: Makkah mein Kaaba Musharrafa aur Masjid-e-Haram hain, jo logon ke liye banaya gaya pehla ghar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ بَنى الكَعْبَةَ نَبِيُّ اللهِ إِبْراهيمُ، وَابْنُهُ إِسْماعيلُ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad banā l-Kaʿbata nabiyyu llāh Ibrāhīm, wa bnuhū Ismāʿīl
dialogue.en: The Prophet of Allah Ibrahim and his son Ismail built the Kaaba.
dialogue.ur: Kaaba ko Allah ke nabi Ibrahim aur un ke bete Ismail ne banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ مَكَّةَ المَشاعِرُ المُقَدَّسَةُ: مِنى، وَمُزْدَلِفَةُ، وَعَرَفاتُ، وَالصَّفا، وَالمَرْوَةُ، وَزَمْزَمُ.
dialogue.tr: wa min Makkata l-mashāʿiru l-muqaddasa: Minā, wa Muzdalifa, wa ʿArafāt, wa ṣ-Ṣafā, wa l-Marwa, wa Zamzam
dialogue.en: Makkah has the holy sites: Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat, Safa, Marwah and Zamzam.
dialogue.ur: Makkah ke muqaddas muqamat: Mina, Muzdalifa, Arafat, Safa, Marwa aur Zamzam.

dialogue.ar: المَدينَةُ المُنَوَّرَةُ: تُعَدُّ المَدينَةُ المُنَوَّرَةُ المَدينَةَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ الثّانِيَةَ بَعْدَ مَكَّةَ؛ إِذْ يوجَدُ فيها مَسْجِدُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: al-Madīnatu l-Munawwara: tuʿaddu l-Madīnatu l-Munawwaratu l-madīnata l-islāmiyyata th-thāniya baʿda Makka; idh yūjadu fīhā masjidu n-nabiyy
dialogue.en: Madinah is counted as the second Islamic city after Makkah, because the Prophet's Mosque is in it.
dialogue.ur: Madina Munawwara Makkah ke baad doosra Islami shehar shumar hota hai, kyunke is mein Nabi ﷺ ki masjid hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي المَدينَةِ مَسْجِدُ قُباءٍ، أَوَّلُ مَسْجِدٍ أُسِّسَ عَلى التَّقْوى، وَفيها جَبَلُ أُحُدٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa fī l-Madīna masjidu Qubāʾ, awwalu masjidin ussisa ʿalā t-taqwā, wa fīhā jabalu Uḥud
dialogue.en: In Madinah is Quba Mosque, the first mosque founded on piety, and also Mount Uhud.
dialogue.ur: Madina mein Masjid-e-Quba hai, jo taqwa par qaim hone wali pehli masjid hai, aur Jabal-e-Uhud bhi yahin hai.

dialogue.ar: القُدْسُ هِيَ المَدينَةُ المُقَدَّسَةُ الثّالِثَةُ عِنْدَ المُسْلِمينَ؛ لِأَنَّ فيها المَسْجِدَ الأَقْصى المُبارَكَ.
dialogue.tr: al-Quds hiya l-madīnatu l-muqaddasatu th-thālitha ʿinda l-muslimīn; li-anna fīhā l-masjida l-Aqṣā l-mubārak
dialogue.en: Al-Quds is the third holy city for Muslims, because the blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque is in it.
dialogue.ur: Al-Quds musalmanon ke nazdeek teesra muqaddas shehar hai, kyunke is mein mubarak Masjid-e-Aqsa hai.

dialogue.ar: المَسْجِدُ الأَقْصى أُولى القِبْلَتَيْنِ، وَقَدْ بَقِيَ قِبْلَةً لِلْمُسْلِمينَ حَتّى السَّنَةِ الثّانِيَةِ مِنَ الهِجْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: al-masjidu l-Aqṣā ūlā l-qiblatayn, wa qad baqiya qiblatan lil-muslimīna ḥattā s-sanati th-thāniyati mina l-hijra
dialogue.en: Al-Aqsa Mosque is the first of the two qiblas; it stayed the Muslims' qibla until the second year after the Hijrah.
dialogue.ur: Masjid-e-Aqsa do qiblon mein se pehla qibla hai; yeh hijrat ke doosre saal tak musalmanon ka qibla raha.

dialogue.ar: القُدْسُ عاصِمَةُ فِلَسْطينَ، اغْتُصِبَها اليَهودُ عامَ ١٩٤٨م.
dialogue.tr: al-Quds ʿāṣimatu Filasṭīn, ughtuṣibahā l-yahūdu ʿāma 1948
dialogue.en: Al-Quds is the capital of Palestine; it was seized in 1948 (the book's wording).
dialogue.ur: Al-Quds Filastin ka daar-ul-hukumat hai; kitab ke mutabiq 1948 mein is par qabza kiya gaya.

q.en: Which is the third holy city for Muslims, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq musalmanon ka teesra muqaddas shehar kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَدينَةٍ هِيَ الثّالِثَةُ المُقَدَّسَةُ عِنْدَ المُسْلِمينَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who built the Kaaba, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Kaaba kis ne banaya?

q.en: Which is the first mosque founded on piety, in Madinah?
q.ur: Madina ki woh masjid jo taqwa par qaim hone wali pehli masjid hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَسْجِدٍ في المَدينَةِ هُوَ أَوَّلُ مَسْجِدٍ أُسِّسَ عَلى التَّقْوى؟

options: The Messenger's birthplace / Rasool ki jaay-e-paidaish
The Messenger's mosque / Rasool ki masjid
The Messenger's journey / Rasool ka safar
The Messenger's book / Rasool ki kitab

title.en: Grammar: Making the verb feminine for the doer
title.ur: Qawaid: Fa'il ke liye fe'l ko muannas karna

intro.en: When the doer (الفاعِل) is a feminine noun, the verb takes a feminine ending: قالَتْ (she said). Sometimes it is a must (واجِب), sometimes it is allowed (جائِز). Example: قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ (the Aziz's wife said) – the verb is feminine because the doer is a real woman right next to it. When a word separates verb and doer, the feminine ending becomes optional.
intro.ur: Jab fa'il (kaam karne wala) muannas ho to fe'l ke saath muannas ki alamat lagti hai: قالَتْ (us ne kaha). Kabhi yeh wajib (واجِب) hota hai aur kabhi jaiz (جائِز). Misal: قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ – fe'l muannas hai kyunke fa'il haqiqi aurat hai aur fe'l ke bilkul saath hai. Agar fe'l aur fa'il ke darmiyan koi lafz aa jaye to tanees jaiz ho jati hai.
intro.ar: إِذا كانَ الفاعِلُ اسْماً مُؤَنَّثاً لَحِقَتِ الفِعْلَ عَلامَةُ التَّأْنيثِ مِثْلَ «قالَتْ». وَيَكونُ ذٰلِكَ أَحْياناً واجِباً وَأَحْياناً جائِزاً. مِثالٌ: «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» وَجَبَ التَّأْنيثُ لِأَنَّ الفاعِلَ امْرَأَةٌ حَقيقِيَّةٌ مُتَّصِلَةٌ بِالفِعْلِ. وَإِذا فُصِلَ بَيْنَ الفِعْلِ وَالفاعِلِ جازَ التَّأْنيثُ وَتَرْكُهُ.

q.en: Which sentence has a feminine verb for the doer?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein fa'il ke liye fe'l muannas hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها فِعْلٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ لِفاعِلٍ مُؤَنَّثٍ؟

q.en: In «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» the feminine ending on the verb is…
q.ur: «قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ العَزيزِ» mein fe'l par muannas ki alamat…

q.en: Which word means "the doer" in grammar?
q.ur: Nahw mein "kaam karne wala" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ في النَّحْوِ؟

title.en: Listening: The People of the Elephant and Two Counsels
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Ashab-ul-Feel aur do wasiyatein

intro.en: Two listening texts. In the first, about Abrahah and the People of the Elephant, you listen and mark each sentence true or false. In the second, two counsels are given about justice and war. Press the audio on the slides, then answer the true/false statements.
intro.ur: Sunne ke do matn. Pehle mein Abrahah aur Ashab-ul-Feel ka waqia hai; sun kar har jumle par sahi ya ghalat ka nishan lagayein. Doosre mein insaf aur jang ke baare mein do wasiyatein hain. Slides ki audio sunein phir jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ. في الأَوَّلِ قِصَّةُ أَبْرَهَةَ وَأَصْحابِ الفيلِ، تَسْتَمِعُ ثُمَّ تُحَدِّدُ صَوابَ كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ أَوْ خَطَأَها. وَفي الثّاني وَصِيَّتانِ في العَدْلِ وَالحَرْبِ. اِضْغَطْ عَلى الصَّوْتِ في الشَّرائِحِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ.

q.ur: "Qazi / jaj (jama)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «مَنْ يَحْكُمونَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ»؟

intro.en: Speaking practice: discuss with your classmate the topics on the page about marriage and family (early or late marriage, marrying a relative or a stranger, many children or few). Prepare points and examples first, then talk.
intro.ur: Bolne ki mashq: apne sathi ke saath shaadi aur khandan ke mauzoat par guftagu karein (jaldi ya der se shaadi, rishtedar mein ya ghair mein, zyada ya kam bachay). Pehle apne nukaat aur misalein tayyar karein phir baat karein.
intro.ar: تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: تُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلِكَ المَوْضوعاتِ المَكْتوبَةَ في الصَّفْحَةِ عَنِ الزَّواجِ وَالأُسْرَةِ (الزَّواجُ المُبَكِّرُ أَوِ المُتَأَخِّرُ، الزَّواجُ مِنَ القَريبَةِ أَوِ الغَريبَةِ، كَثْرَةُ الأَوْلادِ أَوْ قِلَّتُهُمْ). حَضِّرِ الأَفْكارَ وَالأَمْثِلَةَ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمْ.

options_ar: عَقْدٌ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَالمَرْأَةِ لِتَكْوينِ أُسْرَةٍ

title.ur: Qawaid: Maf'ool bihi ko pehle lana

intro.en: Usually the order is verb, doer, then object: فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ (I understood the lesson). Sometimes the object comes first. This is required (واجِب) in some cases, e.g. when the object is a question word like فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ, and impossible (مُمْتَنِع) in others. Example from the Quran: وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ – Ibrahim (object) comes before his Lord (doer).
intro.ur: Aam tarteeb yeh hai: fe'l, fa'il, phir maf'ool: فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ (maine sabaq samjha). Kabhi maf'ool pehle aata hai. Kuch surton mein yeh wajib (واجِب) hota hai, jaise sawali lafz فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ, aur kuch mein mumtani' (مُمْتَنِع, nahin ho sakta). Quran ki misal: وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ – Ibrahim (maf'ool) apne Rabb (fa'il) se pehle aaya.
intro.ar: التَّرْتيبُ المُعْتادُ في الجُمْلَةِ: فِعْلٌ ثُمَّ فاعِلٌ ثُمَّ مَفْعولٌ بِهِ، مِثْلَ «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ». وَقَدْ يَتَقَدَّمُ المَفْعولُ بِهِ؛ وَيَجِبُ ذٰلِكَ في مَواضِعَ مِنْها أَنْ يَكونَ اسْمَ اسْتِفْهامٍ مِثْلَ «فَأَيَّ آياتِ اللهِ»، وَيَمْتَنِعُ في مَواضِعَ أُخْرى. مِثالٌ قُرْآنِيٌّ: «وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهيمَ رَبُّهُ» تَقَدَّمَ المَفْعولُ (إِبْراهيمَ) عَلى الفاعِلِ (رَبُّهُ).

vocab.en: the object (what the action falls on)

q.en: In «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ», which word is the object?
q.ur: «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ» mein maf'ool kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: في «فَهِمْتُ الدَّرْسَ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ المَفْعولُ بِهِ؟

q.en: What does «مُمْتَنِع» mean in these exercises?

options_ar: الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَدُلُّ عَلى الحَدَثِ وَالزَّمَنِ

title.en: Extended reading: Najashi and his guests
title.ur: Wasee parhna: Najashi aur uske mehman

intro.en: A longer story about the Muslims who migrated to Abyssinia (al-Habasha), the king Najashi, the two men sent by Quraysh with gifts, and Jafar ibn Abi Talib's speech about Islam. Read it in parts, then do the exercises (true/false, matching, order the events).
intro.ur: Habsha hijrat karne wale musalmanon, badshah Najashi, Quraish ke bheje hue do aadmiyon aur Jafar bin Abi Talib ki Islam ke baare mein taqreer ki lambi kahani. Hisson mein parhein phir mashqein (sahi/ghalat, milana, waqiat ki tarteeb) karein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ أَطْوَلُ عَنِ المُسْلِمينَ الَّذينَ هاجَروا إِلى الحَبَشَةِ، وَمَلِكِهِمُ النَّجاشِيِّ، وَرَجُلَيْنِ أَرْسَلَتْهُما قُرَيْشٌ بِهَدايا، وَكَلامِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبي طالِبٍ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ. اقْرَأْها عَلى أَجْزاءٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ تَمارينِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالمُطابَقَةِ وَتَرْتيبِ الأَحْداثِ.

dialogue.ar: لَمّا رَأَتْ قُرَيْشٌ أَنَّ أَصْحابَ رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَدْ آمَنوا وَاطْمَأَنّوا بِأَرْضِ الحَبَشَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lammā raʾat Quraysh anna aṣḥāba rasūli llāh qad āmanū wa-ṭmaʾannū bi-arḍi l-Ḥabasha
dialogue.en: When Quraysh saw that the Messenger's companions were safe and settled in the land of Abyssinia…
dialogue.ur: Jab Quraish ne dekha ke Rasool ﷺ ke sahaba Habsha ki sarzameen mein mehfooz aur mutmain hain…

dialogue.ar: ائْتَمَروا بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ يَبْعَثوا مِنْهُمْ رَجُلَيْنِ إِلى النَّجاشِيِّ فَيَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: i-tamarū baynahum an yabʿathū minhum rajulayn ilā n-Najāshiyy fa-yaruddahum ʿalayhim
dialogue.en: They agreed among themselves to send two men to the Najashi so that he would return them.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ke apne mein se do aadmi Najashi ke paas bhejein taake woh unhein wapas kar de.

dialogue.ar: فَبَعَثوا عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ أَبي رَبيعَةَ، وَعَمْرَو بْنَ العاصِ بْنِ وائِلٍ، وَجَمَعوا لَهُما هَدايا لِلنَّجاشِيِّ وَلِلْبَطارِقَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-baʿathū ʿAbdallāh ibn Abī Rabīʿa wa ʿAmra bna l-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil, wa jamaʿū lahumā hadāyā lin-Najāshiyy wa lil-baṭāriqatih
dialogue.en: So they sent Abdullah ibn Abi Rabiah and Amr ibn al-As, and gathered gifts for them to give the Najashi and his bishops.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha Abdullah bin Abi Rabia aur Amr bin al-As ko bheja aur unke liye Najashi aur uske pādriyon ke tohfay jama kiye.

dialogue.ar: فَغَضِبَ النَّجاشِيُّ ثُمَّ قالَ: لا وَاللهِ، لا أُسْلِمُهُمْ إِلَيْهِما.
dialogue.tr: fa-ghaḍiba n-Najāshiyy thumma qāl: lā wa-llāh, lā uslimuhum ilayhimā
dialogue.en: The Najashi became angry, then said: no, by Allah, I will not hand them over to those two.
dialogue.ur: Najashi ghusse mein aaya phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, main unhein in dono ke hawale nahin karunga.

dialogue.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ النَّجاشِيُّ إِلى أَصْحابِ رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ فَدَعاهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: fa-arsala n-Najāshiyy ilā aṣḥābi rasūli llāh fa-daʿāhum
dialogue.en: Then the Najashi sent for the Messenger's companions and called them.
dialogue.ur: Phir Najashi ne Rasool ﷺ ke sahaba ko bulwa bheja.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُمْ: ما هَذا الدِّينُ الَّذي فارَقْتُمْ فيهِ قَوْمَكُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla lahum: mā hādhā d-dīnu lladhī fāraqtum fīhi qawmakum?
dialogue.en: He said to them: what is this religion for which you left your people?
dialogue.ur: Us ne un se kaha: yeh kaunsa deen hai jis ki khaatir tum ne apni qaum ko chhoda?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها المَلِكُ، كُنّا قَوْماً أَهْلَ جاهِلِيَّةٍ، نَعْبُدُ الأَصْنامَ، وَنَأْكُلُ المَيْتَةَ.
dialogue.tr: ayyuha l-malik, kunnā qawman ahla jāhiliyya, naʿbudu l-aṣnām, wa naʾkulu l-maytata
dialogue.en: O king, we were people of ignorance (jahiliyyah): we worshipped idols and ate carrion.
dialogue.ur: Aye badshah, hum jahiliyat wale log the: butoon ko pujte the aur murdaar khate the.

dialogue.ar: حَتّى بَعَثَ اللهُ إِلَيْنا رَسولاً مِنّا، نَعْرِفُ نَسَبَهُ وَصِدْقَهُ وَأَمانَتَهُ وَعَفافَهُ.
dialogue.tr: ḥattā baʿatha llāhu ilaynā rasūlan minnā, naʿrifu nasabahū wa ṣidqahū wa amānatahū wa ʿafāfah
dialogue.en: Until Allah sent us a messenger from among us, whose lineage, truthfulness, trustworthiness and purity we knew.
dialogue.ur: Yahan tak ke Allah ne hum mein se ek rasool bheja, jis ke nasab, sachai, amanat aur paakdamani ko hum jante the.

dialogue.ar: فَدَعانا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ اللهَ وَحْدَهُ، وَلا نُشْرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: fa-daʿānā an naʿbuda llāha waḥdah, wa lā nushrika bihī shayʾā
dialogue.en: He called us to worship Allah alone and to associate nothing with Him.
dialogue.ur: Us ne hamein dawat di ke sirf Allah ki ibadat karein aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek na thehrayein.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمَرَنا بِصِدْقِ الحَديثِ، وَأَداءِ الأَمانَةِ، وَصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ، وَحُسْنِ الجِوارِ.
dialogue.tr: wa amaranā bi-ṣidqi l-ḥadīth, wa adāʾi l-amāna, wa ṣilati r-raḥim, wa ḥusni l-jiwār
dialogue.en: He commanded us to speak truthfully, return trusts, keep family ties and be good to neighbours.
dialogue.ur: Us ne hamein sach bolne, amanat ada karne, rishtedari nibhane aur parosi se achha salook karne ka hukm diya.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمَرَنا بِالصَّلاةِ وَالزَّكاةِ وَالصِّيامِ، فَصَدَّقْناهُ وَآمَنّا بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa amaranā biṣ-ṣalāti waz-zakāti waṣ-ṣiyām, fa-ṣaddaqnāhu wa āmannā bih
dialogue.en: He commanded us to pray, give zakat and fast, so we believed him and had faith in him.
dialogue.ur: Us ne hamein namaz, zakat aur roze ka hukm diya, chunancha hum ne us ki tasdeeq ki aur us par iman laye.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ مَعَكَ مِمّا جاءَ بِهِ عَنِ اللهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ؟
dialogue.tr: hal maʿaka mimmā jāʾa bihī ʿani llāhi min shayʾ?
dialogue.en: Do you have anything of what he brought from Allah?
dialogue.ur: Kya tumhare paas us cheez mein se kuch hai jo woh Allah ki taraf se laya?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan.

dialogue.ar: فَاقْرَأْهُ عَلَيَّ.
dialogue.tr: faqraʾhu ʿalayy
dialogue.en: Then recite it to me.
dialogue.ur: To mujhe woh parh kar sunao.

dialogue.ar: فَبَكى النَّجاشِيُّ حَتّى اخْضَلَّتْ لِحْيَتُهُ، وَبَكَتْ أَساقِفَتُهُ حَتّى أَخْضَلوا مَصاحِفَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: fa-bakā n-Najāshiyy ḥattā akhḍalat liḥyatuh, wa bakat asāqifatuhū ḥattā akhḍalū maṣāḥifahum
dialogue.en: The Najashi wept until his beard was wet, and his bishops wept until their scrolls were wet.
dialogue.ur: Najashi itna roya ke us ki dari tar ho gayi, aur us ke pādri bhi itna roye ke unke sahife bheeg gaye.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ هَذا وَالَّذي جاءَ بِهِ عيسى لَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ مِشْكاةٍ واحِدَةٍ؛ انْطَلِقا، فَلا وَاللهِ لا أُسْلِمُهُمْ إِلَيْكُما.
dialogue.tr: inna hādhā wa-lladhī jāʾa bihī ʿĪsā la-yakhruju min mishkātin wāḥida; inṭaliqā, fa-lā wa-llāhi lā uslimuhum ilaykumā
dialogue.en: Truly, this and what Jesus brought come from one lamp-niche; go away, by Allah I will not hand them over to you.
dialogue.ur: Yeh aur jo Isa lekar aaye, ek hi chiraagdan se niklte hain; chale jao, Allah ki qasam main unhein tumhare hawale nahin karunga.

q.en: Where did the Muslims in this story settle?
q.ur: Is kahani mein musalman kahan base?
q.ar: أَيْنَ اسْتَقَرَّ المُسْلِمونَ في هٰذِهِ القِصَّةِ؟

q.en: Who was the king who protected the Muslims?
q.ur: Musalmanon ki hifazat karne wala badshah kaun tha?

q.en: Who spoke to the king about Islam?
q.ur: Badshah se Islam ke baare mein kis ne baat ki?

q.en: What did Quraysh send with their two men?
q.ur: Quraish ne apne do aadmiyon ke saath kya bheja?

q.en: What was the king's reaction when he heard the recitation?
q.ur: Tilawat sun kar badshah ne kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ المَلِكُ حينَ سَمِعَ التِّلاوَةَ؟

intro.en: A review test with reading, vocabulary and grammar exercises, followed by the answer slides. Try each exercise first, then check the answers. Remember: a feminine verb for a feminine doer, and the object can come before the doer.
intro.ur: Dohrai ka imtihan jis mein parhna, alfaz aur qawaid ki mashqein hain, phir jawabat ki slides. Pehle khud hal karein phir jawab dekhein. Yaad rakhein: muannas fa'il ke liye muannas fe'l, aur maf'ool fa'il se pehle aa sakta hai.
intro.ar: اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ تَمارينُ في القِراءَةِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ وَالقَواعِدِ، يَتْبَعُهُ شَرائِحُ الإِجاباتِ. حاوِلْ كُلَّ تَمْرينٍ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ راجِعِ الإِجابَةَ. تَذَكَّرْ: يُؤَنَّثُ الفِعْلُ لِلْفاعِلِ المُؤَنَّثِ، وَقَدْ يَتَقَدَّمُ المَفْعولُ عَلى الفاعِلِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى لَوْنِ الثَّلْجِ؟

options_ar: غَرْسُ النَّباتِ وَالعِنايَةُ بِهِ لِلْحُصولِ عَلى الغِذاءِ

q.en: Which verb form is correct for a female doer?
q.ur: Aurat fa'il ke liye sahi fe'l kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها الفِعْلُ الصَّحيحُ لِفاعِلٍ مُؤَنَّثٍ؟
